"AllianceHelpKey"="Mighty Alliances form to fight for glory on Erden! \n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Joining an Alliance</color> \n\nYou can press the Search or Ranking buttons while you have no alliance to search for an Alliance to join. Alliances may also advertise when they are recruiting in chat. Some alliances may have a minimum Power required to join. You can also view and respond to invitations to join Alliances by pressing the Invites button. \n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Creating an Alliance</color>\n\nCreate a new Alliance by pressing the \"Create\" button while you have no Alliance. Creating a new Alliance costs 200 Soul Stones. The Alliance name chosen when creating an Alliance cannot be changed later.\n\n\n--- Alliance Fame --- \n\n\nFame is a measure of an Alliance's activity that resets to 0 daily at midnight server time. \n\nFame is ranked across your server, and the final Fame Ranking before reset determines an Alliance's ability to declare attacks on Castles in Alliance Wars the following day. \n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Gaining Fame</color> \n\nAll Alliance members can gain Fame for their Alliance through the following actions: \n\n- Alliance Check-in (Open the Alliance menu) -\n 30 Fame (Once per day) \n\n-Fast Forward with Soul Stones in the Tower of Trials -\n20 Fame \n\n- Explore in the Tower of Trials -\n10 Fame\n\n- Win a Challenge you make in the Arena -\n5 Fame\n\n- Complete an Alliance Quest -\n1 Fame\n\n\n--- Alliance Level --- \n\n\nAlliance Level is increased once enough Alliance Exp is accumulated by an Alliance's members. \n\nAs an Alliance levels up, it will unlock access to more Alliance Quests, and increase its member limit. \n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Gaining Alliance Exp</color> \n\nAll Alliance members can gain Exp for their Alliance through the following actions: \n\n- Alliance Check-in (Open the Alliance menu) -\n100 Alliance Exp (Once per day)\n\n- Complete an Alliance Quest -\nAmount varies depending on the quest completed \n\n\n--- Alliance Features --- \n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Member List</color>\n\nPress the Members button to view current Alliance members and the Chain of Command. Only the Alliance Master may edit the Chain of Command.\n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Alliance Shop</color> \n\nPress the Exchange button to view. Alliance Coins earned through Alliance Quests can be exchanged for other items here.\n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Bulletin Board</color>\n\nStrategists, Generals and Masters can post notices within the Alliance here. \n\n\n--- Private Chat Channels --- \n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Alliance Chat</color>\n\nA private chat channel for use by all Alliance members.\n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Alliance Notice</color>\n\nA private chat channel that Strategists, Generals and Masters can use to send important messages. The rest of the Alliance can only read this channel. \n\n\n--- Alliance Roles --- \n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Master</color>\n\nMaster of the Alliance. Only the Master can kick Alliance members and delegate roles in the Chain of Command. \n\n\n<color=#00edf6>General</color>\n\nA trusted commander of the Alliance. Combines the permissions of the Strategist and Minister to help lead the Alliance where needed. An Alliance can have up to 2 Generals. \n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Strategist</color>\n\nA specialist in Alliance Warfare. The Strategist can post battle plans on the Alliance Bulletin, issue orders during war in Alliance Notice chat, and reorder Platoons in Alliance Wars. An Alliance can only have 1 Strategist.\n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Minister</color>\n\nA specialist in Alliance administration and special liaison for the Alliance. The Minister can perform various Alliance Management tasks, and other players can contact the Minister directly when viewing an Alliance profile. An Alliance can only have 1 Minister. \n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Captain</color>\n\nAlliance members with tactical authority. Captains can reorder Platoons in Alliance Wars. An Alliance can have up to 12 Captains.\n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Knight</color> \n\nAn honorable member of the Alliance. Has no special permissions, but a healthy Alliance needs many strong Knights to thrive. New members begin as Knights and any number of Alliance members can be Knights. \n\n\n--- Managing an Alliance --- \n\n\nMinisters, Generals and Masters have use of the Manage button to perform various tasks. \n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Invite Players</color>\n\nDisplays a list of players that can be invited to the Alliance if desired. The players can be tapped to view their profiles and send an invitation.\n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Entry Requirements</color>\n\nAllows the minimum Power to join the Alliance to be adjusted. Automated application approval can also be toggled here.\n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Applicants</color>\n\nView, accept and reject pending applications to the Alliance.\n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Give Daily Reward</color>\n\nAllows the Daily Alliance Reward to be sent to Alliance chat within set times each day.\n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Advertisement</color>\n\nAllows a special recruitment message to be sent to World Chat. There is a cool down on how frequently this can be done.\n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Alliance Introduction</color>\n\nAllows a special introduction message to be set for when non-members view the Alliance profile. \n\n\n<color=#00edf6>--- Leaving an Alliance ---</color>\n\n\nYou can leave an Alliance by pressing the Leave button or if you are kicked by the Alliance Master. Please note when leaving an Alliance:\n\n- You will not be able to participate in Alliance War until the next day. \n- You will not be able to participate in any current War of the Realms map on behalf of any Alliance.\n- If you have left an Alliance too many times, you will have a 15 hour cool down period before you can join another Alliance. \n\n\n<color=#00edf6>--- Master Inactivity ---</color> \n\n\nThe Master role may be claimed by other Alliance members should the Master not log into the game, as follows: \n\n- 3+ days inactive: Generals \n -4+ days inactive: Minister, Strategist \n- 5+ days inactive: Captains \n- 6+ days inactive: Knights"

"BattalionHelpKey"="Build a mighty battalion to increase your total Power, and use it to fight in Warfare modes! \n\nYour Battalion is comprised of Platoons, which can each hold 5 units. You will begin with just one Platoon, but more will unlock as your Player Rank increases. \n\nPlease note that some Warfare modes specify which Platoons are used, at least 1 Character must be allocated to one of these in order to participate. \n\nBattalion Mode battles differ to battles using your Story Team as follows:\n\n- Platoons have no Cost limit. \n- Battalion Mode battles are played out automatically. As Commander of your Battalion, you can adjust deployment order and Power Up your units to influence your chance of victory. \n- Leader Skills are not used, no Characters fighting in Battalion Mode are considered leaders. \n- Fellowship bonuses will be active, strengthening all of your units according to the Fellowships you have unlocked. \n- Mercenaries are not used. \n- You cannot use more than one copy of the same Character in your Battalion, even if they would not deploy in battle together. \n\n\n--- Battalion Management Tools --- \n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Fill All</color> \n\nPressing this button will automatically fill any available slots in all of your Platoons with available Characters, Weapons, and Accessories. This will be done in order of Highest to Lowest Power. This will not move units that are already assigned to Platoons. \n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Optimize</color> \n\nThe \"Fill All\" button will change to this if all slots in your Battalion are full. Pressing this will automatically adjust your Platoons to maximize the Power it can currently achieve. Please note that Optimize may move units that are already assigned to Platoons. \n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Auto Fill New Units</color> \n\nWhen you Summon your first copy of a Character and you have this toggle on, the new Character will automatically be added to a Platoon and equipped with a Weapon and Accessory (if available). \n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Clear All</color> \n\nPressing this button will allow you to remove all units from your Platoons. \n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Edit Mode</color>\n\nIn this mode, you can move characters between platoons. Equipped weapons and accessories will move with the character. You can also re-order your platoons by tapping the arrows on the right side of the screen.\n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Save/Load Battalion</color>\n\nTap the load button at the top left of the screen to save and load battalion configurations. You can save 10 Battalion formations at one time. You can rename these configurations by tapping on their names in this screen.\n\n\n--- Platoon Management Tools ---\n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Edit</color> \n\nPressing this next to a Platoon (or on the Platoon itself) will allow you to manually edit the respective Platoon. \n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Fill</color> \n\nPressing this button next to a Platoon will automatically fill any available slots in that Platoon with available Characters, Weapons and Accessories. This will be done in order of Highest to Lowest Power. This will not move units that are already assigned to Platoons. \n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Clear</color> \n\nPressing this button next to a Platoon will allow you to remove all units from that Platoon. \n\n"

"GuildWarHelpKey"="Top Alliances fight for glory across Erden in massive Alliance Wars! \n\n\n--- Alliance War Format --- \n\n\n- Alliance Wars are held across 5 different maps. Each map will be contested in an Alliance War for a number of days before moving onto the next map. There may be break days where no Alliance War occurs between maps. \n- The current map in rotation is the same across all servers. If a server opens in the middle of a map's duration, it will have the same number of days remaining as on pre-existing servers. \n- A map's final scoreboard is retained until another Alliance War begins in it. \n\n\n--- Alliance War Phases --- \n\n\nAlliance Wars can be broken down into 5 phases each day. \n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Pre-Declaration Phase: Begins 00:00 (Server Time)</color>\n\nAs a new day begins, the top 16 Alliances in the Fame Ranking on your server are granted Declarations; 2 for the top 8, and 1 for the rest. Declarations will become usable in the next phase.\n\nIf a new map is beginning, 2 Level 1 Castle's are granted to Alliances in Fame Rank order, until no Level 1 Castles remain unheld on the new map. \n\nOnce these things are determined, all Alliance Fame is reset for the new day. \n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Declaration Phase: \nUTC-0500 Servers: 11:00 - 20:00 (Server Time)\nUTC+0200 Servers: 09:00 - 20:00 (Server Time)\nUTC+0900 Servers: 08:00 - 20:00 (Server Time)</color> \n\nIf an Alliance had enough fame the previous day to declare any attack on a Castle, any Alliance member can issue these declaration(s) during this phase. Declaring on a Castle allows your Alliance to attack that castle in the upcoming Battle Phase.\n\nYou may only declare on Castles that are Adjacent to one that your Alliance already holds. If your Alliance does not hold any Castles but qualifies for a Declaration, you may declare on any Level 1 Castle. \n\nYour alliance must hold at least 1 Level 1 Castle to declare on a Level 2 Castle, and at least 1 Level 2 Castle (or 2 Level 1 Castles) to declare on a Level 3 Castle. \n\nOnce a Declaration is issued, it cannot be retracted. \nOnce a Declaration is issued on a Castle, no other Alliance can Declare on that Castle until the next Declaration Phase. \n\nBattalion Data is also saved for the day in the 15 minutes before this phase begins, before updating one more time just before the Pre-Battle Phase. \n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Pre-Battle Phase: 20:00 - 21:00 (Server Time)</color> \n\nIn the 15 minutes before this phase begins, all Battalion data is updated and locked in. Platoons will appear and fight in the upcoming Battle Phase as they were when their data was updated, so any platoon edits during the 15 minutes before the pre-battle phase may or may not be reflected during the Battle Phase as the exact timing can vary. \n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Battle Phase: 21:00 - 21:45 (Server Time)</color> \n\nDuring the Battle Phase, Platoons can be sent to attack Castles which your Alliance has currently declared on. If a Castle is attacked while it has no defending Platoons, it will change hands to be held by the Alliance attacking it, and enters a 15 minute protection period. \n\nFollowing the protection period, the Alliance that previously held the Castle may attack it until the end of the Battle Phase. If the original holders can take the Castle back, it cannot be attacked again that day. \n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Post Battle Phase: 21:45 - 00:00 (Server Time)</color> \n\nWhen the Battle Phase ends, scores are calculated and rewards for the day are distributed. End of map rewards will also be distributed here if it was the final day of a map. \n\n\n--- Platoon Placement --- \n\n\n- Starting in the declaration phase, and until the end of the Battle Phase, Platoons may be placed to defend a Castle your alliance holds. Platoons can also be placed to attack a Castle that your Alliance has declared upon, but only during the Battle Phase. \n- Platoons each have 2 points of Energy for use in Alliance War which resets back to 2 each day. If a Platoon has no Energy left, it cannot be deployed to attack or defend a Castle. \n- If a Platoon is attacking or defending a Castle, it cannot be deployed elsewhere during the current day until it is either defeated or successfully takes a Castle when attacking. \n- If a Platoon is defeated or successfully takes a castle, it will lose 1 point of Energy, and may then be redeployed to attack or defend a Castle if it has any Energy remaining. \n- Platoons will fight in order of which they are placed in a Castle, but you may reorder your Alliance's defending Platoon list if you are a Captain, Strategist, General or Master in your Alliance. The first 3 Platoons in the list cannot move once the battle phase begins. \n\n\n--- Rules for Battles in Alliance War ---\n\n\n- Battles in Alliance War happen automatically and are resolved in a matter of seconds. \n- Alliance War battles use Platoons so no Leader Skills are active, but Fellowship bonuses will apply. \n- The first attacking Platoon deployed to a Castle will fight the first defending Platoon assigned to that Castle. \n- A winning Platoon is fully healed and slightly weakened before continuing to fight the next enemy Platoon assigned to the Castle. \n- When there are no defending Platoons left in a Castle, an attacking Platoon will instead capture the Castle for its Alliance. \n- In Alliance War, the attacking Platoon will always have a starting TU advantage against the defender. \n\n\n--- Other Notes --- \n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Scoring</color>\n\n- At the end of a Battle Phase, each Alliance gains points equal to the total Dominion Points of Castles that they own. \n- At the end of each map, the Alliance with the most points is victorious! \n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Rewards</color>\n\n- Each Castle held at the end of a Battle Phase will grant a Dominion Reward to each Alliance member that deployed any Platoons to Attack or Defend any Castle in the map on that day. \n- After the last Battle Phase of a map, each Alliance member will receive Map Completion Rewards depending on their Alliance's final Score Ranking on the map. \n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Tiebreakers</color>\n\n- In individual battles, draws can occur if all units are defeated at the same time, or a battle resolves in a stalemate after too many turns elapse. A draw will always be considered a victory for the defending Platoon. \n- In Alliance War Score Rankings, scores may occasionally be tied. Ranking order between tied scores is then determined by the previous day's Alliance Fame Rankings, and is finalized at the end of the final Battle Phase of a map. \n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Battle Replays</color>\n\n- Replays of key battles that occurred in a Castle can be viewed when inspecting it.\n- Replays will generally be kept until the end of the Post Battle Phase, but may be cleared whenever battle data is updated. \n\n\n<color=#00edf6>Changing Allegiance</color>\n\nIf you leave an Alliance, you cannot participate in an Alliance War until the next day."

"SupportGiantWallOfTextKey"="○ Attention:\n・Please be sure to check the FAQ at the bottom of this page before sending in a question.\n・Be sure to configure your email client to allow emails from the [@zigzagame.com] domain.\n・Only Japanese and/or English-language inquiries are supported.\n・Depending on the contents of your message, a reply may be delayed, or you may not receive a reply.\n\n\n<About The Game>\n\nQ. Do I have to pay every time I install the game?\nA. After purchasing the game once, the application can be reinstalled as many times as you want for free.\n\nQ. Are there any differences between iOS and Android versions?\nA. There are no differences between the game versions.\nUsers on different platforms can also be matched for PvP and other functions.\n\nQ. My character and weapon stash sizes suddenly went up. What happened?\nA. Character and weapon stash size will increase when your Hero Rank increases, when you purchase Soul Stones, and when certain other conditions are met.\nYou can also use Soul Stones to increase your stash size.\n\n\n<About Game Data>\n\nQ. How do I transfer my account data to another device?\nA. Transferring account data is done with a unique restore code that is assigned to you.\nTake the restore code from the device you are switching from, and input it into the device you are switching to.\nThis process is automated if we detect a restore code backed up for you.\n\nQ. Can I play on multiple devices at the same time?\nA. No, you cannot.\nWhen account data is transferred, the original device will no longer be able to access the account linked to the restore code.\n\nQ. I don't have my restore code. Can I still restore my lost game data?\nA. If you have lost your restore code and we do not detect a backed up, please contact us. You will be asked to confirm several pieces of information regarding your account. (For this reason, we require that only the actual player of the account contact us.)\nIf insufficient information is given to confirm your identity, we reserve the right to refuse to send the restore code. Thank you for your understanding.\n\nQ. Is there a limit on how many times I can use my restore code?\nA. There is no limit on the number of times a restore code can be used.\nEach accountis assigned a restore code upon creation, which cannot be changed.\nBe sure to keep your restore code secure and do not share it with anyone.\n\nQ. If I change my Google account or AppleID info, can I still use the same restore code?\nA. You will still be able to use the same restore code.\n\nQ. I want to start over from the beginning. Can I?\nA. Yes. From the title screen, please select a server you have not yet played on to create a new save file on that server.\nYour account can have separate save data for each server you have played on.\n\n\n<About Servers>\n\nQ. What time zone are timed events scheduled by for each server region?\nA. Events will be scheduled based on either CST, GMT, or JST - whichever time zone is local to the server's region.\n\nQ. Can I move my save data to another server?\nA. Game save data cannot be moved from one server to another.\n\n\n<About Soul Stones>\n\nQ. Can I get refunds on Soul Stone purchases?\nA. Unfortunately, we cannot offer exchanges, returns, or refunds for purchases of digital goods.\n\nQ. What's the difference between paid Soul Stones and unpaid Soul Stones?\nA. Paid Soul Stones are Soul Stones obtained from in-app purchases, while unpaid Soul Stones are received as in-game rewards, etc., for no cost.\nPlease note that when using Soul Stones, paid Soul Stones will be consumed before unpaid Soul Stones.\n\nQ. Can I transfer Soul Stones or VIP level from one save file on my account to another?\nA. Both Soul Stones and VIP level are bound to the save file and Server on which they are earned or purchased and cannot be transferred.\n\n\n<About Battles>\n\nQ. What happens if I Quicken an ally with an active TU Cost Down weapon skill?\nA. Multiple effects that reduce the TU cost of active skills can stack on the same unit if the skills allow, but will have diminishing returns.\n\nQ. How is damage calculated when there are multiple effects decreasing damage?\nA. Damage reduction skill effects can stack on the same unit, incoming damage is reduced by each applicable effect in turn until all have applied. (E.g. 50% reduction of 1400 damage is 700, if reduced by 50% by another skill is a result of 350 damage.)\nThe elemental strength difference between attacking and targeted units applies after all of the above is calculated, and cannot be nullified by attacks which ignore damage reduction effects.\n\n\n<Other>\n\nQ. I sent in a question, but it's been several days and there's been no reply.\nA. Messages received outside of business hours, or inquiries requiring investigation, may take some time for a reply.\nAdditionally, you may not receive a reply if:\n\n・Your question is answered in the Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) page.\n・Your question is answered in the in-game tutorial or Help pages.\n・For any reason, your question is a difficult one to answer.\n\nIn addition, please check your spam folder and email client settings. Make sure that emails from domain [@zigzagame.com] are allowed in your settings."

Ascension grants an additional Attack and HP boost once achieved.\n\n\n--- Mastery --- \n\n\nMastery allows you to increase and customize a Character's Elemental strengths. Mastery level costs Gold and Mastery Scrolls to increase. Please see help in the Mastery screen for more details.\n\n\n"
